sections.title: ZX Bank – Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program

location.heading: ZX Bank – Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program

blocks.text: Welcome to the Personal Relationship Manager (PRM) Assistant Program, an exclusive service designed for all ZX Bank account holders. Our PRM Assistant transforms the way you bank—offering dedicated, professional, and tailored support for your daily financial needs.

sections.title: What is the PRM Assistant Program?

location.heading: ZX Bank – Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program
What is the PRM Assistant Program?

blocks.text: The Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program connects you with a dedicated relationship manager—a friendly banking expert who understands your unique needs. Whether you manage your finances digitally or prefer in-person services, your PRM Assistant will guide and support you, making banking easier and more personalized than ever before.

location.heading: ZX Bank – Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program

items.text: Dedicated Support
Get a named manager as your single point of contact for all banking queries.
Receive priority assistance for account-related concerns, service requests, and troubleshooting.
Efficient Account Management
Assistance with day-to-day transactions: fund transfers, deposits, withdrawals, and more.
Personalized help with cheque books, debit/credit card management, and loan tracking.
Personalized Services
Account usage insights, budgeting tips, and notification of important account activities.
Tailored recommendations on banking products and investment opportunities to suit your goals.
On-Demand Engagement
Connect with your PRM via phone, email, scheduled video calls, or secure chat through ZX Bank Asia mobile app.
Direct appointment booking for in-branch meetings.
Proactive Updates
Timely notifications about offers, maturity dates, and upcoming payments.
Regulatory and compliance alerts to keep you compliant and informed.

sections.title: How The PRM Assistant Helps You

location.heading: ZX Bank – Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program
How The PRM Assistant Helps You

rows: Resolves questions about balances, statements, etc.
Helps set up BillPay, NetBanking, UPI, and more.
Assists in applying/tracking loans; explains options.
Connects with investment specialists as needed.
Manages cross-border transfers and NRI requirements.
Expedites resolution of service or transaction issues.

sections.title: Who Can Use the PRM Assistant?

location.heading: ZX Bank – Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program
Who Can Use the PRM Assistant?

blocks.text: All ZX Bank account holders, regardless of account type, automatically get access to a Personal Relationship Manager Assistant at no extra charge.

sections.title: How to Reach Your PRM Assistant

location.heading: ZX Bank – Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program
How to Reach Your PRM Assistant

items.text: Via ZX Bank Asia App: Tap ‘PRM Assistant’ for secure messaging or video calls.
By Phone: Call your dedicated relationship manager directly (contact found in the app or welcome kit).
In Branch: Schedule a face-to-face meeting at your nearest ZX Bank branch.

sections.title: Why Choose the PRM Assistant Program?

location.heading: ZX Bank – Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program
Why Choose the PRM Assistant Program?

items.text: Personalized attention: A truly customer-centric service experience.
Time-saving: Let your PRM handle the details while you focus on what matters.
Expert guidance: Make informed decisions with your banking ally by your side.

location.heading: ZX Bank – Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program

blocks.text: Experience seamless, stress-free banking with the Personal Relationship Manager Assistant Program—your gateway to premium, personalized service at ZX Bank.
For more information, log in to the ZX Bank Asia app or visit www.zxbank.asia (https://www.zxbank.asia).
